name: Kujou Kohaku
source:
President of the erotic game company “Ramune Soft”. She is also a planner and a PR person. She is a young lady through and through. 

She is a self-reliant person with the ability to take action when she decides to do something. However, she is pure at heart and never gives people a bad impression of her. She is a positive person who always sees the good in things.

 
Her hobby is cosplay. When promoting her new works, she goes to stores and events wearing the costumes that appear in her works, as both a hobby and for practical use. 

Breast shape :Hemispherical

[From [url=https://hadashi.product.co.jp/gamekoi/chartop.html]official site[/url]]
